description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $125m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking a Sr Desktop Support Analyst to join our team!

 

What You’ll Do:  

Desktop & End-User Support

• Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 technical support for employees across macOS and Windows environments.

• Diagnose and resolve complex hardware, operating system, application, network connectivity, authentication, and peripheral issues.

• Serve as an escalation point for difficult or high-impact support incidents.

• Support employees through the complete technology lifecycle, including onboarding, role changes, hardware replacements, and offboarding.

• Configure, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, and related workplace technology.

• Provide remote support to employees across geographically distributed locations.

• Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service while communicating technical information to both technical and non-technical users.

Endpoint Management

• Administer and support Jamf for macOS device management, including enrollment, policies, profiles, software deployment, patching, and troubleshooting.

• Administer and support Microsoft Intune for Windows and mobile device management.

• Maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, security, and software deployment standards.

• Troubleshoot device enrollment, configuration profile, application deployment, encryption, and compliance issues.

• Assist with endpoint lifecycle management, inventory, refresh planning, and asset tracking.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive endpoint management and support activities.

Identity & Access Management

• Administer and support Okta for identity and access management.

• Troubleshoot SSO, MFA, authentication, application assignment, and account provisioning issues.

• Support user provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, and access changes.

• Assist with maintaining role-based access and least-privilege practices.

• Work with Security and other technical teams to investigate authentication and access-related incidents.

IT Service Management

• Use Jira Service Management (JSM) to manage incidents, service requests, problems, and related IT workflows.

• Maintain accurate, detailed, and timely documentation within support tickets.

• Prioritize and manage tickets based on business impact, urgency, and established service-level expectations.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend permanent solutions or process improvements.

• Help develop and improve JSM workflows, queues, request types, knowledge articles, automation, and reporting.

• Monitor support trends and contribute to improvements in service quality and employee experience.

SaaS & Collaboration Platforms

• Administer, support, and troubleshoot core workplace applications, including:

• Google Workspace - Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, Groups, and related administrative functions.

• Slack - user administration, workspace support, application integrations, and troubleshooting.

• Okta - authentication, SSO, MFA, application access

Migration & vault architecture

Identity federation & MFA

Define acceptance criteria and go/no-go gates for pilot and production wave sign-off.
Mentor and provide technical direction to CyberArk Senior Engineers delivering the build.
 
Required experience & skills
10+ years in Identity and Access Management, with 5+ years specifically in CyberArk PAM architecture and design.
Deep hands-on knowledge of CyberArk EPV, PVWA, CPM, PSM, AAM/CCP, and Vault architecture across on-prem and Privilege Cloud deployments.
Proven experience leading a CyberArk version migration (v10/v11/v12 → v13/v14) at enterprise scale.

description:

You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.
This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.
Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

• Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases

• Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process

• Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough

• Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback

• Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right

• Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most

• Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output

• Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report

• Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

description:
Ally and Your Career
Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do - and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too?

Work Schedule: Ally designates roles as (1) fully on-site, (2) hybrid, or (3) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need.
The Opportunity
Are you experienced in customer service and interested in helping customers reach financial well-being? As a Customer Solutions Representative, you will proactively make outbound calls as well as handle inbound calls to efficiently assist customers with their auto loan accounts, providing exceptional service while resolving payment issues in a professional, empathetic, and highly productive manner. We offer a strong brand reputation, competitive benefits, and thorough training in compliance, negotiation, and sales. You will gain valuable skills and contribute to a team that values professionalism and consistent, industry-standard practices.

Compensation: $23/hr. + monthly incentives.

Training classes start: November or December 2026
Training Schedule:
- Monday - Friday: 8am-5pm EST or 7am-4pm CST (weeks 1-4)
- One late night starts in the Launch Program (starts the 1st Tuesday of the 2nd month of training):11am-8pm EST or 10am - 7pm CST

Following training, the required work schedule is as follows:
- Monday through Friday: 8am - 5pm EST or (7am - 4pm CST) or 9am-6pm EST or (8am-5pm CST)
- One late night per week: 11am - 8pm EST or 10am - 7pm CST
- One Saturday per month: 8am - 12pm EST or (7am - 11am CST)
The Work Itself

• Make outbound phone calls and handle incoming calls to meet required performance standards and metrics.

• Contact Ally auto-loan customers regarding late or missed payments.

• Understand reasons for delinquency and negotiate payment arrangements.

• Respond to customer inquiries via phone, workflow systems, and email.

• Research and resolve account discrepancies.

• Document all interactions clearly and accurately.

• Maintain professionalism and accuracy while managing accounts.

• Meet performance standards for call volume, delinquency, and customer satisfaction.

• Identify and recommend solutions to avoid repossession losses.

• Use computerized systems for tracking and troubleshooting.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of customer information.

• Adhere to all state and federal laws in the handling of accounts.

The Qualifications We’re Looking For

• Experience in financial services or a related industry preferred.

• Associate or bachelor’s degree in business or related field may be used in lieu of experience.

• Bilingual (Spanish) skills are a plus.

• Excellent listening, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and professional phone etiquette.

• Sales, negotiation, and skip tracing skills preferred.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Windows and internet-based applications required.

• Ability to multi-task and meet key performance metrics.

• Strong ability to identify potential loss situations and make appropriate recommendations to mitigate loss, with an aptness to escalate unique collections cases to management.

• Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holid
